rdfs:label: holder
rdfs:comment: On a VerifiablePresentation, the Actor presenting the credentials — typically (but not always) also the credentialSubject.
notes: Three roles in a typical VC flow: `issuer` (signs the credential), `credentialSubject` (the entity it makes claims about), `holder` (the entity presenting it now). They're often the same Actor but can diverge — a parent holding a credential about their child, an organisation holding one about an employee.
